stop_reason: User identified side-view source GDI inputs versus posterior-view Auto-Gait recordings. Matching tensor shape does not establish matching projected gait measurements. Do not execute acquisition, pose extraction or GDI association under this protocol. No GDI inference or Slurm submission has been executed for this study.
question: Do unchanged existing GDI predictors follow actual SARA gait scores in Auto-Gait?
authorization: User requested actual Auto-Gait input preparation and comparison using existing frozen GDI models, without target-score fitting.
selection: One earliest explicit visit number per published participant key, selected before GDI inference. Source date tokens have upstream typos; do not repair them. Each participant has exactly one earliest-visit record; one record without a visit token is its sole public record. No substitution after quality failure. Exclude #146 official tandem walking if selected; retain #144 with shoes note and flag #63 occlusion. No score values select records or windows.
input: First chronological 124 native source frames; no padding, repeated frames, concatenation or confidence clipping. Record actual FPS/timestamps and source-training time-axis agreement as unverified. Reuse original BODY25 feature extraction and BODY25->COCO->H36M conversion/normalization separately.
pose: Existing official BODY25 weights and unchanged image normalization, resize, forward network and official OpenPose decoder. Validate original Caffe reference and one new source frame before expanded inference. Track participant using body/leg visibility and pelvis continuity, then visually review 5 anchor frames per selected record before GDI inference.
quality: Retain original CNN required-coordinate missingness<=25% and finite feature checks. H36M additionally requires all six lower-body joints observed throughout and unchanged confidence under normalization. Primary comparison uses common eligible participants; separate available-input supplements retain all eligible participants without cross-cohort model ranking.
models: Same 15 locally reproducible GDI model/combination definitions as 20261031-gdi-external-association/protocol.json; five fixed source fold checkpoints per definition, source-trained calibration unchanged. No new GDI fit, SARA fit or model selection based on external scores.
outcome: Actual original SARA gait Score, full observed range retained. Higher SARA is worse; expect negative association with mean predicted left/right GDI. Do not assume normal controls have GDI=100.
analysis: Person-level Spearman rho and Pearson r, 10000 person bootstrap resamples, 9999 label permutations with plus-one p, Holm adjustment across 15 model tests in primary common cohort; descriptive source-fold/left-right and leave-one-person-out checks. Report score counts before/after exclusions. No clinical success threshold.
storage: Code/small tables/figures/audits on C. Public videos, pose outputs, frame/feature caches and bulk predictions only under the exact D DATA directory. Public videos approximately1.2GB; bounded pose work expected below50GB total, check free space before acquisition and execution.
limits: Exploratory external cohort transfer across age, diagnosis, viewpoint and anonymization. Source person keys are supplied pseudonymous IDs, not a cross-dataset identity audit. Earliest-visit and pose quality exclusions can narrow score coverage. Clinical generalization and precision of SARA prediction are not established by association.
